name: Reasonix
description: Runs a DeepSeek-first coding agent in the terminal, a desktop studio, or VS Code, with cache-aware context handling and other OpenAI-compatible providers via config.

skills.name: Config-Driven Providers
skills.description: Declares providers, the agent, tools, and plugins in reasonix.toml, with DeepSeek as a preset and other endpoints as config.

skills.name: Planner And Executor
skills.description: Runs two models together as an executor and a planner in separate, cache-stable sessions on the same task.

skills.name: Cache-Aware Context
skills.description: Injects a small stable environment summary and prunes stale tool output before summary compaction to keep caches warm.

skills.name: MCP Plugins
skills.description: Adds tools, prompts, and resources from MCP servers, plus Extension Protocol sidecars that intercept runtime events.

skills.name: Editor Integration
skills.description: Runs a local reasonix acp backend that the VS Code extension uses for chat, editor context, and tool-call approvals.
